checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Valid apiLevel 2.15, all volumes within pipette ranges (p1000 250/500 µL, p300 40/100/≤190 µL), reservoir columns ≤15 mL, waste wells ≤1540 µL, simulator passed.

One p1000 tip is reused for 48 wells for isopropanol and for both 500 µL ethanol dispenses at default well-bottom height into sample wells, and one p300 tip dispenses elution buffer into all six columns, so tips contact sample-bead wells and then move to others.
The 100 µL elution buffer is dispensed with no mixing/resuspension of the beads, and shared tips are used across sample wells, so it is not a fully faithful, sound implementation.
Checks '48_samples_to_odd_columns' and 'distinct_elution_wells' pass; the code maps tubes 1–48 to odd-column wells with a fresh p1000 tip each.
Checks for 40/250/250 volumes, 5x mix, 5 min incubation, 4 min magnet and removal with magnet engaged all pass 48/48.
Checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes, magnet_engaged_for_all_removals and air_dry_4min pass; code disengages the magnet before elution.

Step 7 only aspirates/dispenses 100 µL elution buffer into each column with no mixing afterward, so the beads are not resuspended as the rubric requires, though 90 s magnet and 100 µL recovery to distinct wells pass.

judge.summary: The protocol meets the measured checks on sample placement, binding, washes, drying and recovery volume/timing, and its OT-2 practice is sound. It loses the tip-contamination item because single tips are shared across sample wells for isopropanol, ethanol and elution buffer. It loses the elution item and fidelity because the elution buffer is never mixed to resuspend the beads.
